items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 常 in Shuowen seal-script style. The cited historical analysis parses the lower part as 巾 and the upper 尚 as phonetic.

items.selection_reason: The only 常-specific candidate found with inspected source and reuse statements; its form usefully presents the component arrangement cited in the historical account.

limitations.text: This is a modern digital redrawing of a historical script form, not a photograph or facsimile of an ancient object. The browser inspection covered the description/provenance page; it did not inspect the image pixels.

Searches did not establish Commons files specifically for 常 in bronze or Chu manuscript styles. The opened additional-version links led to general script categories, and direct guessed URLs were inaccessible; no such image is proposed.
